The green Hb line runs from 17.1 and 18 at the first dates down to 12.2 and 12.3 at the last two. The blue WBC line starts at 4.05, rises to 10.03 and 10.61, then varies between 5.98 and 9.88 and ends at 11.2 and 11.36. The purple monocyte line starts at 2.1, peaks at 5.57 on 5/2/2024, dips to 1.79 on 17/2/2024 and ends at 4.02 and 3.94. The red ANC line stays flat along the bottom at printed values from 0.01 to 0.08.

visual.general_description: Color microscopy photograph of a bone marrow smear showing several large round cells with purple nuclei among pale gray red blood cells, overlaid with red crosshair lines and numbers.
visual.detailed_description: Color microscope photograph of a smear. Roughly ten to twelve large round cells with pink-purple granular-looking nuclei and a thin rim of lilac to blue cytoplasm are grouped in the lower left and center and at the right; one darker purple cell sits near the top center and two small touching cells lie at the lower right. Between and around them are many pale gray-lilac round cells with lighter centers that are smaller than the large cells. The background is pale greenish-gray. A thin red crosshair overlay with tick marks crosses the image: a horizontal line a little below the middle and a vertical line near the center, with red numbers 100.0, 200.0 and 300.0 along both sides of the horizontal line and 100.0 and 200.0 below and above the crossing on the vertical line. No names, dates or other identifying text are visible and no panel letters are printed.

visual.general_description: Color photograph of an infant abdomen with a small round red raised lesion with a pale center up and to the image left of the umbilicus, a child's hand resting on the upper abdomen, and a diaper at the bottom.
visual.detailed_description: Close color photograph of an infant's bare abdomen lit from the front. A small round red-pink raised lesion with a paler whitish center and a surrounding rim of pink-red skin lies left of center in the frame, about two thirds of the way down. To its lower right in the frame is the umbilicus, with whitish-gray crusted material in the center and a darker red-brown area around it. A hand with fingers curled downward rests on the upper abdomen above the lesion. A pale green-cream garment with a stitched edge is pushed up at the top and a white diaper with a printed band and partly legible printed text is at the bottom. The skin elsewhere is light brown without other visible lesions. No face, genitalia, scale bar, name, date or panel letter is visible.
